features.title: Attma works like a bioinformatician: it plans the steps, runs them on real data, and shows its work.
features.subtitle: From Question to Reproducible Result

items.title: Variant Interpretation
items.description: Annotates variants with Ensembl VEP, gnomAD, ClinVar, AlphaMissense and CADD, and maps missense changes onto UniProt domains and AlphaFold structures.

items.title: Single-Cell and RNA-seq in Python
items.description: Runs scanpy, PyDESeq2 and gseapy in an isolated workspace for each chat: QC, clustering, UMAP, marker genes and differential expression.

items.title: Ask in Your Language
items.description: Type or dictate in 25 languages, switching mid sentence if you like. Attma answers in the language you write in.

items.title: Figures You Can Reuse
items.description: Every step keeps its code, logs, figures and tables, so you can download the results and rerun the analysis yourself.

items.title: Evidence, Graded
items.description: Searches PubMed and the web, reads the abstracts, and grades whether each paper supports a gene for your phenotype, with PMIDs inline.

items.title: Isolated by Design
items.description: Each chat runs its code in its own sandboxed microVM, and requests to the language models are sent with storage turned off.

cases.title: Workflows You Can Run Today
cases.subtitle: Each one runs end to end in a single conversation, in about a minute or two.
cases.viewAll: Talk to us about your data

items.title: Rare Disease Case Review
items.description: Paste a clinical note or attach an exome report. Attma maps the findings to HPO, ranks 12,900 rare diseases and prioritizes the candidate variants. On 200 published cases held out from its index, it ranked the causal variant first in 50.5% of them.
items.prompt: An 18-month-old girl has had prolonged febrile and afebrile seizures since 6 months of age, now with global developmental delay, mild hypotonia and an ataxic gait; MRI is normal. Candidate variants: ENSP00000501589.1:p.Arg1648His, rs1801133, NM_000546.6:c.215C>G. Rank the likely diagnoses and variants, with evidence.

items.title: Single-Cell Atlas in Minutes
items.description: Load PBMC 3k or your own .h5ad: quality control, clustering, UMAP, marker genes, cell-type annotation and pathway enrichment, with every figure and line of code.
items.prompt: Load the public PBMC 3k single-cell dataset, run QC, normalization, clustering and UMAP, find marker genes per cluster, annotate cell types from canonical markers, and run pathway enrichment on the B cell markers.

items.title: From Variant to Structure
items.description: Start from a protein change and get its population frequency, ClinVar status, AlphaMissense score, the domain it hits, AlphaFold confidence at that residue, and the papers that report it.
items.prompt: Annotate the SCN1A variant ENSP00000501589.1:p.Arg1648His: population frequency, ClinVar, AlphaMissense and CADD, which protein domain it falls in and how confident the AlphaFold structure is there, and what the literature says about it.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtext: Find answers to common questions about our pricing plans.

1.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, new features will be immediately available. When downgrading, the change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

2.question: Do you offer academic discounts?
2.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for academic institutions, students, and non-profit research organizations. Please contact our sales team for more information.

3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
3.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), as well as invoicing for annual enterprise subscriptions.

4.question: Is there a free trial for the Pro plan?
4.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial of our Pro plan, giving you full access to all Pro features without requiring payment information upfront.

5.question: What happens when I reach my query limit?
5.answer: When you reach your monthly query limit, you will be notified and have the option to upgrade to a higher tier. You won't lose any of your existing data or analyses.

6.question: How secure is my research data with Attma?
6.answer: We take data security very seriously. All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest. Enterprise plans include additional security features and compliance options such as HIPAA and GxP.
